findings.codeql_raw_query:
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

/**
 * @name Check for SSL verification bypass in httpcore
 * @description Searching for SSL verification being disabled in httpcore package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/ssl-verification-bypass
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember(["create_default_context"]).getACall()
select call, "SSL context creation call - verify if verification is properly configured"
findings.hypothesis: SSL/TLS certificate verification may be improperly disabled in httpcore, especially in proxy handling

message.text: SSL context creation call - verify if verification is properly configured

findings.codeql_raw_query:
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

/**
 * @name SSL verification disabled check
 * @description Check if SSL certificate verification is disabled in httpcore
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssl-verification-disabled
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("create_default_context").getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getACall()
select call, "SSL context created - check if verify_mode is set to CERT_NONE or verification disabled"
findings.hypothesis: SSL certificate verification might be disabled in httpcore's SSL handling

message.text: SSL context created - check if verify_mode is set to CERT_NONE or verification disabled
